quests.title: Crimson Cleansing

dialogue.sit: Alright, then I'm counting on the world's best guide.

dialogue.t: Hehe, no problem! {NICKNAME}, let's get going!

dialogue.sit: I've got another idea. Just come with me, Paimon.

dialogue.t: Wherever you go, Paimon's coming with you! Let's get moving!
If it really is a Seelie, then there should be treasure around here, right? But, uhm, Paimon can't see anything...
Well, since we're already here, why don't we keep going on a bit? This gorge doesn't look that long anyway, and heading back might actually take more time...
If it really is a Seelie, then there should be treasure around here, right? But, uhm, Paimon can't see anything...
Speaking of which, Paimon does remember seeing a similar-looking light orb on the other side of the gorge, but that one was blue...
Let's go take a look over there! Maybe we can finally figure out what these things actually are!
Ooh, Paimon's kinda curious, but it's probably nothing important... right?

quests.description: You spot a strange red orb in the Nothing Passage at the northern end of Lempo Isle…
